items.name: Office 365
items.description: Configure the Wazuh Office 365 audit log integration. Ingest Exchange, SharePoint, Azure AD and General audit events directly into CySIEM for unified cloud visibility.

items.name: Google Cloud
items.description: Configure the Wazuh GCP Pub/Sub integration. Upload your Service Account JSON key to ingest Google Cloud audit logs — Admin Activity, Data Access, System Events — into CySIEM. Custom security rules are deployed automatically.

items.name: Phishing Response
items.description: Auto-triage phishing emails. Extract IOCs, create a CyIRIS case, block sender domain in CySIEM, and notify the SOC team — all in under 60 seconds.
steps: Block domain in CySIEM active response

items.name: Block IP
items.description: Instantly block a malicious IP across all agents via CySIEM active response. Triggered by alert level, CyIRIS case or manual override.
steps: Validate IP is not on allowlist

items.name: IOC Enrichment
items.description: Automatically enrich indicators of compromise from CySIEM alerts. Query VirusTotal, Shodan, and AbuseIPDB, then push enriched data to CyIRIS.
steps: Set ticket priority based on score

items.name: Malware Isolation
items.description: Isolate a compromised endpoint on detection. Quarantine the agent, take a memory snapshot, create a CyIRIS IR case, and alert the on-call analyst.
steps: Isolate agent via Wazuh active response
Create priority CyIRIS case with evidence

items.name: Vulnerability Ticketing
items.description: Automatically create and assign remediation tickets for Critical and High CVEs discovered by CySIEM. Includes SLA tracking and escalation.
steps: Create CyIRIS case with CVE details

items.name: Brute Force Response
items.description: Detect and respond to brute force login attempts. Temporarily block offending IPs, alert the user, and create an investigation case.
steps: Extract source IP and target account
Block IP for 1 hour via active response
Auto-close if no further activity in 24h
